crossRefs.note: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon with

people.name: Abiel
people.line: Father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.
